title: isodon eriocalyx
intro: Isodon eriocalyx, commonly known as Himalayan isodon, is a plant species within the family Lamiaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various ailments, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and promote mucus discharge, as well as its role in regulating blood pressure and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Isodon eriocalyx include iridoids, phenolic compounds, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
